scope: Additional visible main-branch alert 16, alongside the existing v2.1.1 CodeQL review

alert.assessment: The flagged wrap_socket belongs to a loopback-only negative test that requires an expired fixture certificate to fail with verification code 10 before any HTTP request. The test uses create_default_context, preserves hostname and certificate checks and never configures a deployed endpoint. The production probe explicitly sets TLS 1.2 minimum, hostname checking and CERT_REQUIRED in deploy/https_health.py:141-145. No production protocol downgrade or actionable issue was established.

limitations: This is a scoped review of the additional alert; it does not claim zero open alerts or a fresh review of all older alerts.
The local TLS default observation is for Python 3.12.14, not a measurement of the hosted 3.12.10 runner.
